title: Scripts and measurements for an audit of receptor preparation in molecular docking
description:
Scripts and measurement tables for an audit of the receptor preparation steps that precede molecular docking.

A resolution-stratified sample of 100 single-chain protein crystal structures from the RCSB PDB was prepared with PDB2PQR 3.8.0 from four inputs (the file as downloaded, and three derived inputs that keep all, the non-water, or none of the HETATM records), and with Meeko 0.8.0 with and without its bad-residue flag, under both default-altloc settings, and with the ligand kept. The deposit records the resulting titration states, the residues whose state depends on whether the ligand was present, the residues on which the two tools assign different formal charges, the residues deleted by Meeko's bad-residue flag, the coordinate differences made by the default altloc setting, the difference in electrostatic potential the two charge sets produce on the receptor contact surface, and the output of an input-file validator over the sample.

The 100 PDB files (38 MB) and the intermediate files (pqr and pdbqt, 229 MB) are not included; their sha256 checksums are, so that regenerated files can be verified against the ones measured here. See README.md for the two-stage reproduction procedure and environment.md for the tool versions and the network conditions each measurement was made under.

The companion audit of partial-charge assignment for metallomacrocyclic ligands is a separate deposit.
